new_findings.scope: Wizard E2E selector strategy regression risk
new_findings.issue: Three out of four kiosk wizard scenarios (S-KIO-03 + S-KIO-04 Bowl + S-KIO-04 Tacos) reach category page instead of wizard. While Wave A agent honestly flagged this as INCONCLUSIVE, the test SPEC selector strategy uses getByText('Sandwich Cayenne'|'Tacos'|'Bowl').click() which lands on the SIDEBAR category label rather than the PRODUCT TILE 'Personnaliser' ribbon. Future test cycles will keep producing INCONCLUSIVE wizard runs until the locator strategy is migrated to a tile-specific data-test attribute or aria-label 'Personnaliser …'.
new_findings.recommendation: Add data-test='kiosk-product-tile-{id}' OR data-test='kiosk-personnaliser-{id}' on the yellow Personnaliser ribbon in the kiosk catalog component, then change the E2E spec to .locator('[data-test^=kiosk-personnaliser]').first().click() before asserting wizard-step DOM. Pure test infrastructure improvement — not a V1 blocker but blocks future visual proof of WIZ-2..WIZ-7.

new_findings.issue: OrderService.php is 1900+ LOC after the +42 LOC heal at line 1822. The cash-escrow + cash-mirror + audit-log + broadcast orchestration sits in a single Service. Container-resolved cross-Service calls (app(...)) inside try/catch fences is a code smell for an otherwise constructor-injection architecture.
new_findings.recommendation: BACKLOG V1.0.X — extract a CashEscrowOrchestrator that owns the cash-mirror + audit-log fan-out. Inject DeliveryBoyCashSessionService via constructor. Do NOT do this for V1 LOCAL — risk of regression > benefit.
